paper_metadata.title: Quantum beetle antennae search: a novel technique for the constrained portfolio optimization problem

summary: QBAS: a quantum-inspired variant of Beetle Antennae Search derived by placing the fitness-gradient particle in a Schrodinger Delta potential and using |Psi|^2 sampling for position updates. Applied to mean-variance Sharpe-ratio portfolio selection (penalty-based unconstrained formulation) on Shanghai Stock Exchange 50 Index stocks including Amazon (AMZN), Facebook (FB), IBM, Google (GOOGL) over 21-Mar-2019 to 18-Apr-2019. Tested on 20/50/75/100-stock portfolios and on four benchmark functions (Ackley, Rastrigin, Beale, Levi-N.13). Compared to BAS, PSO, GA: QBAS achieves highest Sharpe ratio and objective F(E) on all four portfolio sizes, with faster convergence (~40 iterations vs ~90 for PSO/GA).

experiments.description: QBAS on constrained portfolio optimization for SSE-50 Index stocks across 4 portfolio sizes (20, 50, 75, 100 stocks). Sharpe-ratio objective (Eq. 10) augmented with penalty terms for budget and bounds constraints (Eq. 13). Run for 100 iterations. Compared with BAS, PSO, GA under identical computational budget.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Beetle Antennae Search (QBAS): BAS update replaced by sampling from |Psi(y)|^2 = (1/L)e^(-2|y|/L) from Schrodinger Delta-potential solution.
algorithm.ansatz: Wavefunction Psi(y) = (1/sqrt(L)) e^(-|y|/L); update X_n = X_{n-1} +/- (L/2) ln(1/u), u ~ U[0,1], with L = |C*DeltaF|/g, g > ln(sqrt(2)).

hyperparameters.penalty_weights_beta1_to_beta4: adjustable (paper does not report specific values)

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Continuous weights E_i in [0,1] encoded directly as real-valued particle position. Sharpe-ratio maximization with equality (sum=1) and bound constraints added as penalty terms.
problem_formulation.constraints: sum(E_i)=1 (equality, penalty beta2); 0 <= E_i <= 1 (bounds, penalty beta3, beta4).

problem_instance.dataset_name: Shanghai Stock Exchange 50 Index (SSE 50) including AMZN, FB, IBM, GOOGL

dataset_specification.description: Portfolio sizes: 20, 50, 75, 100 stocks drawn from the SSE-50 universe plus listed US tech stocks.

results.notes: Target 1.0; QBAS closer than PSO (0.828) or GA (0.996).

speedup_claims.notes: QBAS converges in ~40 iterations vs ~90 iterations for PSO/GA (Figures 3/4). No asymptotic speedup claimed.

complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: O(20K) time, O(4N+7) space; K iterations, N decision variables (stocks).
